Add state modifier class names to Document, Page, and Thumbnail (#2120)

Adds `--no-data`, `--loading`, and `--error` modifier classes to Document and Page wrappers so their containers can be styled for each state. Thumbnail receives the same modifiers on its inner page wrapper.

Document, Page, and Thumbnail tests, TypeScript, and Biome pass.

Closes #2057
